name: Depth-based Clipping for Focus and Context Volume Rendering
definition: A technique to decompose a volume into a high-quality 'focus' region and a lower-quality 'context' region using depth-based clipping and early-z rejection, implemented in four rendering passes to maximize fragment shader discard efficiency.
summary: Depth-based Clipping for Focus and Context Volume Rendering decomposes a volume into high-quality focus and lower-quality context regions using four rendering passes and early-z rejection to support arbitrary convex clip objects efficiently.
